reasons: Claimed status is compliant with no redline and no comment, which is the expected output shape; the rendered redline is identical to the original paragraphs.

Cited text supports the preferred position: compensation is usage-based user fees (p0056), no minimum-volume commitment, early-termination fee, stipulated damages or penalty payable by Licensee is present; p0049 preserves only accrued payments for trades already performed, not remaining contract value.

Adjacent items were correctly triaged as non-LD: the audit cost-shift on a >5% discrepancy (p0064) is conditional cost reimbursement, and Article XXIII (p0142) bars termination damages mutually, which runs in our favour and is not flaggable.
No actionable proposal is required for a compliant finding; retained as internal evidence rather than a negotiation issue.
